decision: Does the unchanged current-observation masked linear softmax reach the frozen train-only convergence criterion when only its maximum update timebox is expanded?

diagnostic_basis.timebox_rationale: L1b ended less than a factor of two above the frozen train-gradient threshold; a 10000-update ceiling provides at most five times the L1b optimization time while preserving immediate train-only early stopping

fit.validation_use: evaluate exactly once after the train-only stopping rule; never select an update, tolerance, temperature, or optimizer

gate.calibration: BC validation corrected ECE-10 must be no more than corrected action-frequency ECE-10 plus 0.02
gate.optimization: after at least 100 updates, final train gradient L2 must be no more than 0.01 times its all-zero initialization value
gate.proper_score: the upper endpoint of the 2000-draw episode-bootstrap 95% interval for BC minus action-frequency validation NLL must be below zero
gate.timebox: stop immediately when the unchanged train-only gradient criterion passes, or after 10000 full-batch updates; if the criterion still has not passed, report inconclusive and test a deterministic convergence-suitable optimizer next

hypothesis: If the unchanged full-batch optimizer only needed more train-only optimization time, the identical from-zero linear fit will reach the frozen 0.01 relative-gradient criterion within 10000 updates; held-out validation is evaluated once only after that stop and cannot select the stopping point.
non_goals: no warm start from either rejected or inconclusive model
no feature, history, architecture, optimizer, learning-rate, L2, target, comparator, split, seed, reward, or gate change
no temperature scaling or validation-selected training choice
no IQL, auxiliary head, HIT-reduction, or NMNB claim

online_canary.scope_if_later_admitted: one complete natural-RNG original-Wine Lunatic Practice Stage 4 integration run; not training or policy-improvement evidence
